description: This file defines the SkillService class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for managing skill entities, including CRUD operations and searches.

classes.name: SkillService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling business logic related to skills, utilizing SkillDao for data operations.

methods.name: getSkillDao
methods.description: Returns the SkillDao instance, instantiating it if not already set.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Saves a Skill entity to the database.

methods.name: getSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill entity by its ID.

methods.name: deleteSkills
methods.description: Deletes multiple skills given their IDs.

methods.name: searchSkill
methods.description: Searches for skills based on filter parameters, throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Gets the count of skills matching filter parameters, throws ServiceException on failure.
